entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
I can certainly look into that for you. Do you have your order number handy?

Of course. I've just initiated the return in our system. You'll receive an email shortly with a prepaid shipping label. Just pack the cycling shoes in their original box, attach the label, and drop it off at any post office. Once we receive it, we'll issue a full refund to your original payment method.
Whatever. Just make sure the email actually comes through.

Alright. Well, thank you for calling VeloFit, and I hope you have a great rest of your day.
